scenes.say: This is the Studio, the newsroom behind Habit's daily Shorts. One PIN, and you're in.
scenes.caption: The Frameflow Studio: one PIN, and you're in.

scenes.say: Here's today's run. Every afternoon, Frameflow finds three stories for the day's lane, and picks one.
scenes.caption: Each day: three stories found, one picked.

scenes.say: You can follow it step by step. Picked. Made. Approved. And now, queued to post at eleven thirty.
scenes.caption: Picked, made, approved, queued for 11:30.

scenes.say: Open a posted video, and here's the Short itself. Written, drawn and voiced, with nobody editing by hand.
scenes.caption: The finished Short: written, drawn and voiced automatically.

scenes.say: Below it, every automatic check it passed. And how the reviewer scored it, row by row.
scenes.caption: Every automatic check, and the review, row by row.

scenes.say: The same story becomes a carousel post too. Same facts, same sources.
scenes.caption: The same story as a carousel post.

scenes.say: And it learns. Every review, and every note, becomes a lesson that shapes the next video.
scenes.caption: Reviews and notes become lessons for the next video.

scenes.say: Have a look around. Today's run is live.
scenes.caption: Have a look. It's live.
